name: The Scaly Valley
source:
The Scaly Valley is a 18+ visual novel set in a classic fantasy world that blends magic and dragons with lewd stories.

Build deep and soft relationships with your companions. Interact with them, and together overcome all the challenges on your path!

[From [url=https://igazella.itch.io/the-scaly-valley]itch.io[/url]]
